summary: Implemented the open/wrap_file reader feature in rich/progress.py (private _Reader and _ReaderContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads), added 16 tests to tests/test_progress.py before the script-entry block, added "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections to docs/source/progress.rst, and added one Unreleased/Added bullet to CHANGELOG.md referencing PR 1759. Nothing committed. Tests, black, isort, and mypy were not run because the task forbade running repository code; verification was by reading only. Choices to review: _Reader gets concrete mode and name properties (BinaryIO declares them abstract), readinto uses getattr since BinaryIO lacks it, a non-literal str overload was added for mode, and mode 'tr' returns a binary reader per the exact-match rule.
